Strategy: When the item size is divisible by 3 the rule is Best Fit, but for other item sizes it takes the emptiest bin, so the item size modulo 3 flips the preferred bin. It differs from Best Fit only for items not divisible by 3. It may help if size classes correlate with packing roles, or fail because divisibility by 3 has no packing meaning and may flip good choices.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) if item % 3 == 0 else r) for r in bins]
```
